name: routes_per_line
note: sale.order.line.route_ids many2many owner (addons/sale_stock/models/sale_order_line.py:16): routes per order line with the lowest route id, as the delivery rules read them
source_sql: SELECT sale_order_line_id AS line_id, count(*) AS routes, min(stock_route_id) AS first_route FROM sale_order_line_stock_route_rel GROUP BY sale_order_line_id ORDER BY sale_order_line_id

name: lines_per_route
note: the inverse side: order lines per stock route with the lowest line id
source_sql: SELECT stock_route_id AS route_id, count(*) AS lines, min(sale_order_line_id) AS first_line FROM sale_order_line_stock_route_rel GROUP BY stock_route_id ORDER BY stock_route_id
